name: Exp_BlauErgodic
summary: This EA trades based on the Blau Ergodic oscillator indicator, which is a smoothed momentum-based indicator. It supports three entry modes: zero-line breakout, histogram direction change, and signal cloud color change. Positions are opened and closed systematically based on the selected algorithm mode with configurable lot sizing and stop-loss/take-profit levels.
summary_zh: 该EA基于Blau Ergodic振荡指标进行交易，该指标是一种平滑的动量类指标。它支持三种入场模式：零线突破、柱状图方向变化和信号云颜色变化。根据所选算法模式系统性地开仓和平仓，支持可配置的手数大小和止损/止盈水平。
strategy_analysis: 该EA的核心策略基于Blau Ergodic指标，这是一种经过多重平滑处理的动量振荡器。指标通过四层平滑（XLength1-XLength4）对价格动量进行处理，再生成信号线，形成柱状图和信号云。EA提供三种入场模式：breakdown模式在柱状图穿越零线时入场，twist模式在柱状图方向发生变化时入场，cloudtwist模式在信号云颜色（上下线交叉）发生变化时入场。出场条件包括止损和止盈（以点数设置），以及反向信号触发平仓（需开启相应权限）。仓位管理通过MM参数控制，支持按存款比例或固定手数两种方式，由MMMode参数决定。资金管理方面，EA使用GlobalVariableDel_函数在去初始化时清理全局变量，并利用IsNewBar机制避免同一K线内重复交易。策略整体属于动量跟踪类型，在趋势启动时跟随动量方向入场。
strategy_analysis_en: The core strategy of this EA is based on the Blau Ergodic indicator, which is a momentum oscillator processed through multiple layers of smoothing. The indicator applies four smoothing stages (XLength1-XLength4) to price momentum, then generates a signal line to form a histogram and signal cloud. The EA offers three entry modes: breakdown mode enters when the histogram crosses the zero line, twist mode enters when the histogram direction changes, and cloudtwist mode enters when the signal cloud color changes (upper/lower line crossover). Exit conditions include stop-loss and take-profit set in points, as well as reverse signal-triggered position closing (with corresponding permissions enabled). Position sizing is controlled by the MM parameter, supporting either deposit share percentage or fixed lot size as determined by the MMMode parameter. For money management, the EA cleans up global variables on deinitialization using GlobalVariableDel_ and employs the IsNewBar mechanism to prevent duplicate trades within the same bar. The overall strategy is a momentum-following type, entering in the direction of momentum when a trend is initiating.

parameters.name: MM
parameters.description: 入金比例或固定手数，负值为手数
parameters.description_en: Deposit percentage or fixed lots; negative = lots

parameters.name: Deviation_
parameters.description: 最大价格偏差点数（滑点容忍度）
parameters.description_en: Max price deviation in pips (slippage tolerance)

parameters.name: Mode
parameters.description: 入场算法模式：零线突破/方向变化/云颜色变化
parameters.description_en: Entry mode: zero-line breakout / direction change / cloud color change

parameters.name: SignalBar
parameters.description: 获取入场信号的K线编号

pros: 提供三种灵活的入场模式，适应不同市场状态和交易风格
使用多重平滑的Blau Ergodic指标，有效减少噪音信号，提高信号质量
具备完整的多空开平仓权限控制，可灵活配置交易方向
采用IsNewBar机制防止同一K线重复交易，避免过度交易
止损止盈参数齐全，风险控制手段完备
支持多种平滑算法和价格类型，参数可调性高
pros_en: Provides three flexible entry modes to suit different market conditions and trading styles
Uses multi-layer smoothed Blau Ergodic indicator to effectively reduce noise and improve signal quality
Complete buy/sell open/close permission controls allow flexible configuration of trading directions
Employs IsNewBar mechanism to prevent duplicate trades within the same bar, avoiding overtrading
Stop-loss and take-profit parameters are fully available, providing complete risk control measures
Supports multiple smoothing algorithms and price types with high parameter configurability
cons: 多重平滑导致指标滞后严重，可能在趋势初期错过入场时机
止损止盈以固定点数设置，未考虑市场波动性（ATR），在不同行情下风险暴露不一致
缺少加仓和仓位调整逻辑，无法在趋势延续时增加盈利
没有传播过滤器，在高传播时段可能导致不利成交
指标参数过多（四层平滑+信号线+动量周期），优化难度大且容易过拟合
SignalBar默认为1意味着使用已收盘K线信号，但如果设为0则可能在未完成K线上产生不稳定信号
cons_en: Multiple smoothing layers cause significant indicator lag, potentially missing entry opportunities at trend onset
Stop-loss and take-profit are set as fixed points without considering market volatility (ATR), leading to inconsistent risk exposure across different market conditions
Lacks position scaling or adjustment logic, unable to increase profits during trend continuation
No spread filter, which may lead to unfavorable fills during high-spread periods
Too many indicator parameters (four smoothing layers + signal line + momentum period), making optimization difficult and prone to overfitting
SignalBar defaults to 1 (closed bar signals), but setting it to 0 may produce unstable signals on incomplete bars
improvements: 引入ATR动态止损止盈，根据市场波动性自动调整风险水平
增加传播过滤器，避免在高传播时段交易以减少滑点损失
添加趋势过滤器（如更高时间周期的MA方向），避免在震荡市中被反复止损
增加追踪止损功能，在趋势运行中锁定更多利润
improvements_en: Introduce ATR-based dynamic stop-loss and take-profit that automatically adjusts risk levels based on market volatility
Add a spread filter to avoid trading during high-spread periods and reduce slippage losses
Add a trend filter (e.g., higher timeframe MA direction) to avoid repeated stop-outs in ranging markets
Add trailing stop functionality to lock in more profits during trend continuation

risk_points: 多重平滑指标滞后性可能导致入场延迟和趋势末期才进场
固定点数止损未适应不同市场波动环境
参数过多容易导致过拟合，实盘表现可能大幅偏离回测
缺少传播过滤器，在高传播环境下可能遭受较大滑点
risk_points_en: Multi-layer smoothing indicator lag may cause delayed entries and entering at trend尾声
Fixed-point stop-loss does not adapt to different market volatility environments
Excessive parameters may lead to overfitting, with live performance potentially deviating significantly from backtesting
Lack of spread filter may result in significant slippage under high-spread conditions
